import heapq

def optimal_file_merge(sizes):
    heapq.heapify(sizes)
    total = 0
    while len(sizes) > 1:
        a = heapq.heappop(sizes)
        b = heapq.heappop(sizes)
        total += a + b
        heapq.heappush(sizes, a + b)
    return total

print(optimal_file_merge([20, 30, 10, 5, 30]))
